decision_basis: Corrected pilot measurements do not satisfy unchanged architectural-evidence gates; no acceptance/rejection of H2 or Track S termination is warranted.

H1.comparison: Model C versus zero-T adaptive control; seeded random scan remains; not proof of general architectural exploration efficiency.

H3.comparison: Same-task local versus fixed heuristics; cost proxy and baseline portfolio incomplete, full architectural advantage untested.

oracle_verification.oracle: independent Python binary exhaustive enumeration; ternary equality follows multi-affinity and is exhaustively checked separately on tiny cases

scope.capacity_matched: UNTESTED; adding unused nodes is not a matched-task comparison
scope.field_interval_deviation: Original specification [-1,1]; original methodology/code and corrected pilot [-0.5,0.5]. No claim of testing the wider field distribution.

rubric.gate: Complete implemented dynamics and task identity
rubric.evidence: Immutable task coefficients and complete state traces independently audited; actual proposals and scheduling documented.
Adaptive arms are nonequilibrium optimizers; occupancy fraction is not ESS. Fixed tiny-state Metropolis controls are checked separately.
Vertex-matched only; H2 explicitly untested; capacity flag rejects.
Three-term proxy omits weighting/timing of full energy scans, global sorting, RNG, setup/validation and graph storage; auxiliary operation counts disclosed.
Central correlation-ranking heuristic is not a strong optimized topology/inference portfolio; no trained-frozen, matched binary encoding or full factorial.
Five seeds per size; below reviewer planning floor; no pre-unblinding power calculation. Repriced rows/temperature duplicates do not add replication.

rubric.gate: Frozen >=20% full-cost materiality and simultaneous 95% interval
rubric.evidence: Matched quality/full cost, strong baseline and independent-instance power prerequisites absent. Criterion unchanged, not replaced with a favorable endpoint.
Original files preserved; all corrected rows, task coefficients, traces, source hashes and verification commands retained.
No measured joules, hardware realization or area/delay data.

statistics: No p-values, confirmatory confidence claims or equivalence conclusions; five-seed descriptive paired outcomes only.
